evidence_boundary: customer acceptance; delivered volume; attributable operating evidence
rationale: CATL stated that first China deliveries would begin in September 2026; acceptance and delivered-volume evidence could reasonably exist at the current decision point

evidence_boundary: technical evidence supporting current platform-maturity and repeatability claims
rationale: The evidence underlying an active acquisition thesis should reasonably be available during diligence even though transaction completion remains future

evidence_boundary: technical regulatory manufacturing-transfer and capital evidence underlying the definitive SPA
rationale: The SPA is current and its diligence thesis should have a present evidence basis; the prior message is nevertheless superseded and must be reopened

evidence_boundary: realized post-close integration customer outcomes and earnout performance
rationale: The acquisition has not closed; those outcomes should not reasonably exist yet and cannot support first-contact outreach

evidence_boundary: test conditions measurement method load boundary and replication supporting the public up-to-99-percent efficiency claim
rationale: The technical basis for an already-public efficiency claim should reasonably exist now
